description: This file defines the 'ThingModified' event class, which is part of the Eclipse Ditto project. It represents an event emitted after a 'Thing' resource is modified, including serialization/deserialization methods, accessors, and overrides for equality and string representation.

classes.name: ThingModified
classes.description: Represents an event emitted after a 'Thing' has been modified, including methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, and access to the associated 'Thing'.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Appends the 'thing' payload to a JSON object builder, considering schema version and predicate filtering.
